_readme: Messages in chats listed in `internalChatIds` are: (1) posted to platform `/api/otp/official` so login codes are stored for the logged-in website user, (2) saved to the internal archive server (`npm run archive:serve`), kept readable for `deleteDelaySeconds`, then deleted from Telegram for all participants. On every login/reconnect the latest 100 messages of each internal chat are swept, so messages received while the tab was closed are still forwarded, archived, and deleted when the client connects again. Ids use the same format as in hiddenChats.json: a user id for a person (e.g. "123456789"), a chat id with the leading minus for a group (e.g. "-1001234567890"). `archiveApiUrl` is the base URL of the archive server. Rebuild the app after editing.
